extras.real_size: cutaway differential, ring gear 16.4 cm, overall about 51 x 33 x 24 cm
extras.notes: Teaching cutaway of a rear axle differential: painted axle housing with a quarter cut away (cut faces red), axle tubes and pinion neck. Inside: ring gear (module 4, 41 teeth) and drive pinion (11 teeth) sharing one cone apex on the axle, open differential case with two side gears (16 teeth) and two spider gears (10 teeth) on the cross pin, axle shafts with wheel flanges and studs. Stands on two cradles on a base plate. Rotating parts: 'rotor_a' (case, ring gear, spider and side gears, axle shafts, axis X) and 'rotor_b' (pinion, shaft and companion flange, axis Y), origins on the axes. Ratio 41:11.

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
